title.en: Bands of the three powers and heights

statement.en: The bands of the three powers (first and second, third and fourth, fifth and top) and the heights are two divisions of the places: together they fix a place, neither is a function of the other, and each band spans one seam, the band of man the junction of the halves.
statement.zh: 三才之带（初二、三四、五上）与高度是位之两种划分：合之定一位，各不为他之函数，每带恰跨一缝，人带所跨为两半之交。

laws.en: Two places with the same band and the same height are one place; the band of each place and the seam of each band are listed, each band spanning exactly its seam; no map from heights gives bands and none from bands gives heights.
laws.zh: 带与高度皆同之两位是一位；列出每位之带与每带之缝，每带恰跨其缝；无由高度给带之映射，亦无由带给高度者。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; the six places and their heights as defined in HexagramPlaces.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；HexagramPlaces 所定义之六位及其高度。

does_not_show.en: That the three powers are heaven, man and earth in any sense beyond the division.
does_not_show.zh: 三才在划分之外之天、人、地之义。
